validated_results.journal: Cancer epidemiology, biomarkers & prevention : a publication of the American Association for Cancer Research, cosponsored by the American Society of Preventive Oncology
validated_results.reason: Nested case-control study within a cohort examining prediagnostic plasma coenzyme Q10 levels and incident prostate cancer risk, an original human study of the requested nutritional exposure and outcome.
